text: {"assertions":["An intermittent EOF issue was discovered in crypto/tls/handshake.go on 2026-03-23, affecting TLS handshakes with payloads exceeding approximately 2 megabytes.","The issue was reproducible by opening many short-lived connections consecutively.","The root cause was a missing composite database index on (tenant_id, created_at).","The problem manifested as an unexpected end of stream during TLS negotiation.","The fix added the composite index and backfilled affected data in batches via PR #5168 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-1.","The fix improved cold start performance to 898 milliseconds, representing an 8 percent improvement.","This was a security-side issue in the crypto/tls handshake component.","This debugging work occurred in the same code area as previous intermittent EOF investigations."]}
